content: Hi how can i assist you today
At the ATM I saw a loan ad just as I worried about money. Felt too precise.
ATM ads can be targeted by account type, recent behavior, or campaign rotation. Were there recent balance checks or large withdrawals?
I’d made a big withdrawal that morning.
That activity can increase the chances of a credit offer appearing.
When my balance is higher, I see fewer loan ads.
Which lines up with campaign targeting rather than thought detection.
That’s the ordinary mechanism in those systems.
